pr.body:
## Summary
- Add atomic claim endpoint to ConPort (`POST /api/custom_data/claim`)
- Propagate through DopeconBridge and shared client
- Replace Task Orchestrator pre-read/upsert with atomic claim
- Versioned fingerprint v1 for deterministic idempotency

## Claim contract
Result: CREATED | MATCHED | CONFLICT | LEGACY_UNFINGERPRINTED | OWNER_ERROR

## Safety
- Linearization point inside ConPort PostgreSQL transaction
- No schema migration
- Legacy rows fail closed
- Bridge remains proxy only

## Validation
- ConPort claim tests (7 tests, including 20-way concurrency)
- Bridge client tests
- Task Orchestrator atomic idempotency tests
- Two-replica concurrency live proof

steps.task: Trace ConPort custom_data schema, DB driver, transaction API; confirm uniqueness identity and serialization feasibility without migration.
Implement POST /api/custom_data/claim with transactional INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + read-back comparison. Add comprehensive tests.
validation: 7 tests pass: first claim CREATED, identical MATCHED, conflict CONFLICT, legacy LEGACY_UNFINGERPRINTED, 20 concurrent identical, 20 concurrent conflicting, generic upsert compatibility

steps.task: Add claim route to dopecon-bridge, ConPort client method, and shared bridge client sync/async methods.
validation: ConPort client calls new claim endpoint

steps.task: Remove pre-read/upsert in create_epic. Add fingerprint v1 computation + atomic claim with all 5 result handling.
Run all validation, concurrency live proof, embedded audit, PR Steward, and evidence packaging.
validation: Live proof returns zero overwrites, one row per identity
PR Steward records state without unauthorized merge
